constraints: Test UK visa invitation letter flow thoroughly. Available cities: Bangalore, North Goa, Mumbai, Chennai, New Delhi.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
name: UK visa - select and go back options
goal: Verify Select and Go Back options work for all cards in the UK visa flow

phases.description: Navigate to the city selection step
